_readme: Editable website configuration. See documentation/EDITING_GUIDE.md. Defaults MUST equal the original code (enforced by validation/test_model_equivalence.py). Change label, symbol, units, description, min, max, step, scale, references freely. To turn a fixed parameter into a slider, move its entry from 'fixed' to 'sliders' and add scale/min/max. An empty units string means 'not stated in source' and is shown as such on the website.

variants.label: Empirical model
variants.description: Parameters chosen by manual fitting to the experimental data.

variants.label: Ab initio (first-principles) model
variants.description: Uses the first-principles ('_fp') values: Eset_fp and Ereset_fp from reference papers; alpha_fp (via beta_fp) calibrated against the experimental data.

sliders.name: k_attempt
sliders.label: Attempt frequency
sliders.classification_note: Physical meaning (attempt frequency); value chosen for best fit (manual fitting).
sliders.description: Prefactor of the Arrhenius switching rate for both SET and RESET.

sliders.name: alpha
sliders.label: Barrier-lowering coefficient
sliders.classification_note: Raw alpha as used in the code (alpha = beta/(L q) in the original). Empirical: fitted; ab initio: beta_fp calibrated to experimental data.
sliders.description: Field-induced lowering of the activation barrier, entering as alpha*q*|V|.

sliders.name: Eset
sliders.label: SET activation energy
sliders.units_source: Verilog-A line 23 comment (not stated in the Python source)
sliders.classification_note: Empirical: manually fitted. Ab initio (Eset_fp): from reference papers (to be added).
sliders.description: Activation barrier of the SET (OFF to ON) transition.

sliders.name: Ereset
sliders.label: RESET activation energy
sliders.units_source: Verilog-A line 24 comment (not stated in the Python source)
sliders.classification_note: Empirical: manually fitted. Ab initio (Ereset_fp): from reference papers (to be added).
sliders.description: Activation barrier of the RESET (ON to OFF) transition.

sliders.name: n_set
sliders.label: Ideality factor (V >= 0)
sliders.classification_note: Used as in the code (selected by voltage polarity, V >= 0). Physical interpretation to be added by the author.
sliders.description: Ideality factor in the Schottky current term for V >= 0.

sliders.name: n_reset
sliders.label: Ideality factor (V < 0)
sliders.classification_note: Used as in the code (selected by voltage polarity, V < 0). Physical interpretation to be added by the author.
sliders.description: Ideality factor in the Schottky current term for V < 0.

sliders.name: p_set
sliders.label: SET window exponent
sliders.description: Exponent of the SET window (1 - w)^p_set.

sliders.name: p_reset
sliders.label: RESET window exponent
sliders.description: Exponent of the RESET window w^p_reset.

sliders.name: Go
sliders.label: Metallic conductance
sliders.classification_note: Value chosen for best fit. G_metallic = Go (N_channels = 1 ignored, decision B1).
sliders.description: Conductance of the metallic (ON-state) current path, I_met = Go * V.

sliders.name: Is
sliders.label: Schottky saturation current
sliders.description: Prefactor of the Schottky (OFF-state) current term.

fixed.name: q
fixed.label: Elementary charge
fixed.units_source: not stated in Python source (Verilog-A: Coulombs)
fixed.classification_note: Value exactly as written in code: 1.6*10**-19.

fixed.name: vt
fixed.label: Thermal voltage
fixed.classification_note: Fixed at 0.026, independent of T (decision B2).

fixed.name: current_floor
fixed.label: Plot current floor
fixed.classification_note: Display floor for the log axis only; not physical (decision B9).
